GAP ANALYSIS ADDENDUM:

G4 - Add integration assertion to test-defense-matcher.sh:
Test: simulate a defense record being written with cited_lines=['runner.py:42'] and read back through 
review_mirror_defenses_to_pr to assert the cited_lines field survives the roundtrip.
Implementation: write a temp DEFENSE_RECORD JSON to a temp file, pipe through review_mirror_defenses_to_pr 
(using a mock gh), assert the output JSON retains cited_lines.
This verifies DD1 end-to-end (not just structural grep).
